title: Interface Wiring Diagram
description: Visual map of the integration landscape. Derived from the Interface Catalogue (INT-IFC) and Application Domains & Platforms (APP-DAP) — no authored data. Shows platform-to-platform connections with flow counts on a landscape view, and interface-level detail on a per-pair drill-down.

meta.description: A visual map of the integration landscape, derived from INT-IFC and APP-DAP.
purpose: Show the full integration landscape across all platforms at a glance.
Reveal which platforms are most heavily integrated and which are isolated.
Drill down into individual platform pairs to review the interfaces between them.
Communicate integration complexity and coupling to stakeholders and architects.
